verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no export feature: no bulk download, no export of findings in open formats such as JSON, CSV or SARIF, and no account-exit or data-portability path. The v1 API's read access to scan, repository and vulnerability data, and MCP retrieval of vulnerability evidence, are developer building blocks a user could use to construct an export. They are not the export capability itself, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
